introduction: North Carolina Food and Nutrition Services provides grocery benefits through EBT. County DSS handles eligibility and interviews.
description: North Carolina Food and Nutrition Services provides grocery benefits through EBT. County DSS handles eligibility and interviews.

sections.who: Household income and circumstances affect eligibility. The caseworker determines the budget and applicable rules.
sections.get: Approved households receive food assistance. The application date can affect the first month’s benefit.
sections.docs:
• Identity and household details.
  • Income, resources and monthly bills.
  • Relevant dependent-care or medical expenses.
sections.apply:
1. Apply promptly

    Use ePASS, county DSS or mail. Do not delay for missing proof.

  2. Complete the interview

    Options include phone, in-person or video; a chosen representative can participate.

  3. Send verification

    Provide the requested information and save receipts.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using FNS application and documents. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Must every document be ready first?
No. Submit and add information afterward.
Phone or video options are listed.
